newsitem.title: USA: Republic to buy Mitch Pierce auto dealerships.
newsitem.headline: Republic to buy Mitch Pierce auto dealerships.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc., led by Florida billionaire Wayne Huizenga, said Monday it has a definitive agreement to pay businessman Mitch Pierce $48 million in stock for his three car dealerships in Arizona.
The outlets include Tempe Toyota, the AutoMart Superstore and Tempe Toy's Budget Lot, with combined revenues of about $143 million in 1996.
The deal is being accounted for as a pooling of interests, and is subject to manufacturer and government approval.
Republic, based in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., said Pierce, 39, will sign a long-term employment agreement with Republic and will continue in his role at the dealerships.
Republic is a diversified holding company with subsidiaries operating in the solid waste services, electronic security services, automotive rental and automotive retailing industries.
Its stock fell $1.125 to $31.625 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
